bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/ (api.rs StoreApp catalogue, mod.rs browse/GET/OPEN/Updates, install.rs sha256-checked installs); springboard/ui/src/entitlement.rs (Ledger, Transaction), springboard/ui/src/subscription.rs (Period, Renewal, State), springboard/sdk/src/review.rs (Policy, ReviewRequests); no purchase or payment API
summary: BifrOSt has a free app catalogue and installer (browse, install, update, changelog, sha256 check), which covers the product-page and download side of the App Store. Pure models now cover subscription periods and renewal state, a ledger of purchases with entitlements, refunds and finish, and an app-side limit on review requests; purchases, signed transaction verification, offers, the review prompt itself and StoreKit-style testing are still missing.

features.note: StoreApp has id, name, version, size, sha256, category, changelog; no price, currency, product type or subscription fields

features.bifrost: none; springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs installs free packages only
features.note: no payment sheet, no purchase result type, no paid-app install path

features.apple: Transaction, Transaction.updates, Transaction.all, Transaction.currentEntitlements, Transaction.latest(for:), finish(), unfinished
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/entitlement.rs (Ledger::record, latest_for, all_for, current_entitlements, is_entitled, revoke, finish, unfinished)
features.note: pure ledger of purchases with refunds, grace periods and finish; nothing records purchases from a store yet, the ledger is not persisted and no SDK call exposes it to apps; installed state stays in apps/installed.json (install.rs)
package hash is checked; there is no signed-receipt or signed-transaction verification and no std-only signature check

period arithmetic (days to years, month clamping) and renewal state (subscribed, grace period, billing retry, expired); no subscription groups, no billing or renewal from a store; state variant names are BifrOSt's, not verified against the SubscriptionStatus state list (that page was not retrievable)

features.feature: Offers, offer codes and win-back offers
features.apple: Product.SubscriptionOffer, OfferType, offer code redemption, win-back offer sheet
features.note: no offer data in the catalogue
tied to the App Store product page; BifrOSt would need a store-side promotion model first

features.feature: App Store product page and overlay
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/mod.rs (browse, app detail, GET and OPEN actions)
features.note: the built-in store shows app detail and changelog; no embedded product sheet for other apps and no App Clip overlay

features.apple: No direct StoreKit equivalent (App Store download and update); closest is StoreDownloaderExtension
features.note: installs resume and verify sha256; no background asset-pack downloads for apps

features.feature: App transaction (purchase of the app itself)
features.apple: AppTransaction, AppStore.sync, original purchase date and version
features.note: BifrOSt apps have no signed record of how they were obtained

features.apple: AppStore: manage subscriptions, sync transactions, environment, device verification
features.note: no account-level store service in the SDK; cloud accounts are in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, not exposed to apps through an SDK API
regional App Store storefront has no BifrOSt counterpart
app-side limit on how often a review is asked (minimum gap, maximum asks per window) as a pure model; the store's rating prompt is not shown by the shell yet, so request() only records the decision
App Store-delivered messages depend on the App Store service

features.apple: StoreKit Test, sandbox testing, Xcode testing for IAP
features.note: no commerce test harness; SDK testing kit is springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs, not purchase-aware
Apple ad attribution; no BifrOSt advertising system

features.feature: External purchase and external link account
features.note: entitlement-gated Apple programmes for EU, Japan, Korea and the EEA

features.feature: Payment method binding and Store Downloader extension
features.note: Apple Account and Apple-hosted asset packs

gaps: No purchase API: no product lookup with price, no purchase flow, no paid-app install path (springboard/src/shell/store/api.rs has no price or product type).
The transaction ledger (springboard/ui/src/entitlement.rs) is not fed by a store and not exposed to apps: no SDK call, no persistence, no purchase records from the catalogue.
No signed transaction verification (JWS) beyond the package sha256 check in springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs.
No subscription groups, billing or renewal from a store, and no offers, offer codes or win-back offers; the renewal model in springboard/ui/src/subscription.rs is pure.
The review prompt is not shown: springboard/sdk/src/review.rs limits the asks but the shell has no rating prompt yet.
No StoreKit-style test harness for purchase flows in springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs.
Storefront, App Store messages, ad attribution, external purchase and payment method binding are Apple-service specific and have no counterpart (status n/a).
